Together, these findings reveal that individual -power and -burst dynamics could constitute memory-based time-tracking mechanism that aging reshapes in ways that manifest behaviorally under naturalistic conditions.

items.title_en: The vagus nerve drives cognitive function through the default mode network
items.abstract_en: The afferent vagus nerve transmits interoceptive signals to the brain but a systematic understanding of how vagal signals affect brain-wide neuronal dynamics remains elusive. Here, comprehensive spatiotemporal analyses across the entire mouse brain revealed that vagus nerve stimulation activated neuronal ensembles within the default mode network (DMN). In contrast, vagal-independent mechanisms predominantly affected the salience network. The vagal-DMN association was mediated by locus coeruleus neuronal subpopulations. Selective activation or silencing of vagal-responsive DMN neuronal ensembles replicated or abolished VNS-induced enhancement of cognitive behaviors and progressive problem-solving behaviors. These findings establish a unifying framework for how the vagus nerve drives cognitive functions by engaging the DMN.

items.title_en: Grasping Under Target Size and Location Uncertainty
items.abstract_en: Everyday actions often require movements to be planned before the exact target is known, yet most research on grasping has examined situations in which individuals reach toward a single, well-defined object. The present study investigated how grasping actions are planned under target uncertainty using a go-before-you-know (GBYK) paradigm, in which participants initiated their movement before knowing which of two potential objects would become the target. Using 3D motion capture, we examined whether peak grip aperture (PGA) was influenced by the size of a competing nontarget object. Participants grasped cylindrical objects that varied in size under two conditions: GBYK, in which target identity was revealed after movement initiation, and know-before-you-go (KBYG), in which the target was known prior to movement onset. Across two experiments, participants appropriately scaled grip aperture according to the target object in both conditions. However, during GBYK trials, PGA was influenced by the presence of a larger nontarget object. Specifically, when grasping a small target paired with a large nontarget, participants produced larger grip apertures, whereas a small nontarget did not influence grasping toward a large target. This asymmetric interference pattern is inconsistent with a motor averaging account, which predicts bidirectional shifts toward an intermediate aperture. Instead, the findings suggest that under conditions of uncertainty, grasp planning incorporates competing object information in a manner that prioritizes successful object acquisition. Together, these findings extend research on action planning under uncertainty beyond reaching and highlight the dynamic nature of grasp planning when multiple potential targets are present.

items.title_en: MAP3K7 Loss of Function Causes Dilated Cardiomyopathy
items.abstract_en: Background and Aims: Dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) is a genetically heterogeneous cause of heart failure and sudden cardiac death. Many patients remain without a molecular diagnosis. MAP3K7 encodes TAK1, a serine/threonine kinase important for cardiac homeostasis. MAP3K7 variants are an established cause of syndromic disease, including cardiospondylocarpofacial syndrome (CSCF), in which DCM has been occasionally reported. Here, we demonstrate that MAP3K7 variants can cause apparently isolated DCM, expanding the phenotypic spectrum of MAP3K7-related disorders. Methods: We integrated four lines of genetic evidence: de novo variation, common variant association, familial segregation, and rare variant enrichment, alongside functional characterisation. Results: In 117 paediatric cardiomyopathy trios from the 100,000 Genomes Project, two probands harboured rare de novo MAP3K7 missense variants, significantly more than expected (Bonferroni-adjusted p=0.036). Independent GWAS implicated MAP3K7 as a susceptibility locus for adult DCM. Across global DCM cohorts, we identified families harbouring rare MAP3K7 variants, including one with segregation in nine affected relatives (p.(Tyr125Cys), estimated LOD = 2.7). Rare damaging non-truncating variants were enriched in DCM versus INTERVAL (OR 22, p=0.007) and gnomAD controls (OR 14, p=6.2x10-4), while truncating variants were associated with DCM in Genomics England and increased left ventricular volumes in UK Biobank. DCM-associated variants reduced TAK1 kinase activity, supporting a loss-of-function mechanism consistent with CSCF-associated alleles. Conclusion: Multiple independent lines of evidence establish an association between MAP3K7 loss of function variants and DCM. Several affected individuals lacked overt syndromic features, demonstrating that MAP3K7-related disease may present as apparently isolated DCM across the lifespan and supporting inclusion of MAP3K7 in DCM diagnostic pipelines.

items.title_en: Automated, Component-Level Assessment of a National Inpatient Diabetes Guideline: Adherence and Its Association with Hospitalization Complications Across Six Hospitals
items.abstract_en: Objective: To measure adherence to a national inpatient hyperglycemia guideline at the level of its individual recommendations across a hospital network, to determine whether it changed after the guideline was issued, and to identify which recommendations track subsequent outcomes. Materials and Methods: Retrospective multicenter study of 48,354 admissions among 29,577 adults with diabetes or inpatient hyperglycemia at six Israeli general hospitals, August 2022 to December 2025. Each of 14 recommendations was formalized as a quality-assessment temporal pattern over knowledge-based temporal abstractions of the record, scored wherever it applied. Pre-post adherence was compared by Welch t-test with false discovery rate correction. Associations with 10 complications were estimated by bias-reduced logistic regression over 24-, 48-, and 72-hour windows, and by inverse probability of treatment weighting contrasting above- with at-or-below-median adherence. Results: Adherence ranged from near-universal admission and medication-management actions to substantial gaps in insulin management (means, 0.15-0.28). Overall adherence rose modestly after issue (0.682 to 0.703, P < .001), with marked inter-hospital heterogeneity. After weighting, above-median adherence carried 44% lower odds of 30-day mortality (odds ratio [OR], 0.557; 95% CI, 0.514-0.603), 82% lower odds of hyperglycemia (OR, 0.175) and 52% lower odds of severe hyperglycemia (OR, 0.485), against 20% higher odds of hypoglycemia (OR, 1.204). Discussion: The least-implemented recommendations were largely those whose adherence tracked outcomes: repeated insulin decisions spread across a stay, rather than discrete actions on admission. Conclusion: Guideline adherence can be assessed automatically and per-recommendation at national scale, identifying where fuller implementation would most plausibly matter. Keywords: inpatient diabetes; clinical guideline adherence; quality assessment; temporal abstraction; electronic health records; propensity score; causal inference

items.title_en: Diagnostic Concordance of Immediate Versus 1-Hour Technetium-99m Hydroxymethylene Diphosphonate Scintigraphy in Suspected Transthyretin Amyloid Cardiomyopathy
items.abstract_en: Background: Bone-avid tracer myocardial scintigraphy for transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM) traditionally employs 1- or 3-hour imaging intervals. Technetium-99m hydroxymethylene diphosphonate (99mTc-HDP) has unique kinetics that may enable earlier imaging. We investigated the diagnostic concordance of immediate versus 1-hour acquisitions. Methods: Consecutive patients with suspected ATTR-CM underwent planar imaging and SPECT/CT immediately and at 1-hour following 99mTc-HDP administration. Perugini grades, heart-to-contralateral lung ratios, and target-to-background ratios (TBRs) using the LV septum against the aorta, LV blood-pool, and vertebrae were assessed. We evaluated diagnostic concordance using Cohen's kappa (k), temporal stability using paired t-tests, and correlation using Pearson's coefficient (r), with 1-hour SPECT/CT as the reference standard. Results: Forty-eight patients (83% male; median age, 80 years) were evaluated. One-hour SPECT/CT identified 19 positive and 29 negative cases. Immediate SPECT/CT demonstrated 100% diagnostic concordance with the 1-hour reference standard (k = 1.000; p < 0.001). The LV septum/blood-pool TBR showed highest correlation (r = 0.956; p < 0.001). Aorta TBR correlated highly (r = 0.918; p < 0.001) and remained stable in negative patients (-0.02; p = 0.54). Significant vertebral TBR decreases occurred across cohorts due to skeletal clearance. Conclusions: Immediate 99mTc-HDP SPECT/CT demonstrated high diagnostic concordance with standard 1-hour acquisitions, offering a practical approach to improve laboratory throughput.

items.title_en: Updated Health Opportunity Cost Estimates for 92 Low- and Middle-Income Countries: Implications for Global Health Financing and Donor Allocation
items.abstract_en: Background: Estimates of the marginal cost per disability-adjusted life year (DALY) averted from government health expenditure (GHE) provide an empirical basis for allocating scarce health resources to maximise population health. Existing cross-country estimates have informed priority setting in several countries and international policy discussions but are based on data that are now more than a decade old, during which patterns of health expenditure, disease burden, and global health financing have changed substantially. Methods: This paper provides updated estimates of the marginal cost per DALY averted for 92 low- and middle-income countries (LMIC), applying previously estimated elasticities of the effect of GHE on health outcomes from Ochalek et al. (2018) to recent mortality, morbidity, population, and GHE data. We model two scenarios: (1) countries raising domestic health expenditure to a tiered minimum of 10% or 15% of general government expenditure, depending on current level, with Abuja Declaration-consistent results for African Union countries reported separately; and (2) reallocating development assistance for health (DAH), considering both the targeting of existing on-budget support and the potential of the full DAH envelope. We use the estimated elasticities to reflect diminishing marginal returns to health expenditure when calculating the health gains associated with additional resources. Results: Updated estimates of the marginal costs per DALY averted range from approximately $54 to $18,547 across countries (average across DALY measures). In most countries (68%), estimates are higher than in the previous analysis, largely reflecting differences in GHE. Increasing domestic expenditure to the tiered minimum would avert 145 million DALYs but require $392 billion across countries. Reallocating the $11.2 billion in on-budget DAH according to country-specific opportunity costs would avert 75.3 million DALYs compared to the estimated 45.3 million averted by the current allocation of on-budget spending, though this requires redirecting funding away from many currently-funded countries. There is further potential to avert 66.1 million DALYs by optimally allocating the 25.7 billion portion of the DAH envelope that comes from off-budget, NGO and philanthropic resources, measured against a baseline in which they avert no DALYs. Conclusion: Updated estimates provide an empirical basis for informing both domestic priority setting and the allocation of international health financing. Aligning donor funding with country-specific opportunity costs could substantially increase the global health gains achieved with limited resources.

items.title_en: Quantifying Cancer Clinical Trial Eligibility Using Artificial Intelligence-Based Matching
items.title_zh: 使用基于人工智能的匹配量化癌症临床试验资格
items.abstract_en: PURPOSE: To develop and validate an artificial intelligence-enabled platform that combines efficient screening with explicit eligibility logic by converting unstructured cancer trial criteria into reusable structured queries, and illustrates potential eligibility using synthetic patients. METHODS: We downloaded actively recruiting US interventional treatment trials for advanced/metastatic breast cancer, colon cancer, and non-small cell lung cancer from ClinicalTrials.gov. Medical oncologists created 24 synthetic patient vignettes. A large language model converted trial eligibility criteria into Structured Query Language (SQL) code and patient information into structured records, enabling rule-based matching without further LLM inference. Cancer details and treatment history were considered, but not laboratory results or comorbidities. Validation included physician editing of generated eligibility code for 30 trials and independent assessments by two physicians, followed by consensus adjudication, for eligibility across ten trials. We descriptively summarized potential eligibility by trial characteristics and when varying age, ECOG performance status, sex, and ZIP code. RESULTS: Of 833 candidate trials, 746 met inclusion criteria. Performing matching for all 746 trials took a median of 0.459 seconds per patient, excluding patient-data preparation. Against physician consensus, automated matching agreed on 230/240 patient-trial pairs (95.8%; sensitivity 83.3%, specificity 100%). Across synthetic patients, potentially eligible trials ranged from 10 to 258 without geographic restrictions. Counts decreased with worse performance status and geographic restriction and were relatively stable across ages 30-90. Later-phase, randomized, and molecularly selective trials generally matched fewer vignettes. CONCLUSION: LLM-generated SQL enables rapid, explicit rule-based screening for potential trial eligibility. Evaluation in synthetic vignettes supports feasibility, while missed matches underscore the need for further validation.

items.title_en: EDIT-B Consortium: An External Pan-European Validation of an Innovative Machine Learning-Based Test for Bipolar Disorder Diagnosis
items.title_zh: EDIT-B 联盟：用于双相情感障碍诊断的创新机器学习检测的泛欧洲外部验证
items.abstract_en: Background Differentiating bipolar disorder (BD) from major depressive disorder (MDD) during major depressive episodes remains a significant challenge. EDIT-B is an in vitro diagnostic test based on machine learning (ML) method integrating clinical metadata with adenosine-to-inosine (A-to-I) RNA editing signatures in eight genes (GAB2, IFNAR1, IL17RA, LYN, MDM2, PRKCB, PTPRC, ZNF267) to differentiate BD from MDD. Objective The objective of this study is to assess and confirm the diagnostic performance of EDIT-B in a new, independent, double-blind, external multicenter European cohort. Methods We evaluated EDIT-B results across four European centers (Spain, France, Denmark), compared to physician diagnoses. Explainability and sensitivity analyses were performed to identify the primary drivers of the model. Findings In 393 patients with current major depressive episode (238 MDD; 155 BD), EDIT-B demonstrated robust performance: AUC-ROC of 0.873 (95%CI: 0.837-0.909); sensitivity of 82.6% (95%CI: 75.7-88.2%); and specificity of 80.3% (95%CI: 74.6-85.1%). Performances were consistent across sites and all stratified patient subgroups, corroborating previous results. Explainability analysis pointed RNA editing biomarkers as the most important variables for EDIT-B diagnosis. Conclusion This study confirms the diagnostic performances of EDIT-B showing that A-to-I RNA editing coupled with ML methods is a reliable approach to distinguish BD from MDD. Clinical implications EDIT-B represents an innovative, reliable, and complementary diagnostic tool supporting psychiatric practice and enhancing clinical outcomes with potential impact in reducing the diagnostic delays, tailoring the therapeutic strategy and improving therapeutic alliances. These findings may represent a significant advance toward precision psychiatry, with potential to reduce misdiagnosis and inappropriate treatment.
items.abstract_zh: 在重性抑郁发作中区分双相情感障碍（BD）与重性抑郁障碍（MDD）是重大挑战。EDIT-B 是基于机器学习的体外诊断检测，整合临床元数据与 8 个基因的腺苷到肌苷（A-to-I）RNA 编辑特征来区分二者。本研究在西班牙、法国、丹麦四个欧洲中心进行独立、双盲、外部多中心验证，以医生诊断作参照。在 393 例当前重性抑郁发作患者（238 例 MDD，155 例 BD）中，EDIT-B 的 AUC-ROC 为 0.873，敏感度 82.6%，特异度 80.3%，各站点和亚组一致；可解释性分析显示 RNA 编辑标志物最重要。研究确认其诊断性能，表明 A-to-I RNA 编辑联合机器学习可可靠区分 BD 与 MDD，有望辅助诊断并减少延迟。
items.highlight_zh: EDIT-B 多中心验证诊断双相障碍 AUC 0.873
items.digest_zh: 双相情感障碍（BD）和重性抑郁障碍（MDD）在抑郁发作时症状相似，单靠临床访谈很难区分，常导致误诊和延误治疗。EDIT-B 是一种体外诊断检测，它把临床元数据与 8 个基因（GAB2、IFNAR1、IL17RA、LYN、MDM2、PRKCB、PTPRC、ZNF267）中的腺苷到肌苷（A-to-I）RNA 编辑特征结合起来，用机器学习模型区分 BD 和 MDD。本研究在西班牙、法国、丹麦的四个欧洲中心开展独立、双盲、外部多中心验证，以精神科医生诊断作为参照。共纳入 393 例当前处于重性抑郁发作的患者（238 例 MDD，155 例 BD）。结果显示 EDIT-B 的 AUC-ROC 为 0.873，敏感度 82.6%，特异度 80.3%，且在各中心和不同亚组中表现一致；可解释性分析表明 RNA 编辑生物标志物是模型判断的最重要变量。该研究验证了 EDIT-B 的诊断性能，提示 A-to-I RNA 编辑联合机器学习可可靠区分 BD 与 MDD，有望减少诊断延迟、优化治疗策略，作为精神科临床的辅助工具。

items.title_en: Predicting Unseen Scientific Interactions: Conditional Flow Models Hallucinate Non-Additive Effects
items.title_zh: 预测未见过的科学相互作用：条件流模型幻觉出非加性效应
items.abstract_en: Conditional generative models are increasingly used for scientific prediction beyond the direct training support. Yet scientific questions often concern whether one intervention changes the effect of another. Such interactions can be of primary interest while explaining little of the total variation, allowing models to appear accurate overall without recovering the relevant scientific effect. It remains unclear how these models learn interactions and when these successfully extrapolate to unseen conditions. We therefore study interaction recovery in flow-matching models using a physiological time-series simulator, drug dose-response data, combinatorial cell perturbations, and molecular conformer generations, where we separate recovery from hallucinated interaction structure. In the controlled setting, individual effects are learned much earlier than interactions and models hallucinate interactions where none exist. Across settings, we find qualitatively different generalization problems, with successful prediction depending on whether condition structure continues from observed to held-out targets. When it does, interactions are recoverable. If not, models can generate plausible responses while missing the interaction. We furthermore find that hallucinations increase as targets become less identifiable, and that successful interaction recovery in output space can fail under nonlinear readouts. Finally, we show that aggregate fidelity metrics can conceal whether models learn and extrapolate interactions.

items.title_en: A Col22a1-EGFP reporter reveals dynamic three-dimensional organization of the myotendinous junction
items.title_zh: Col22a1-EGFP报告基因揭示肌腱连接处的动态三维组织方式
items.abstract_en: The myotendinous junction (MTJ) is a specialized extracellular matrix-rich interface that transmits contractile force generated by skeletal muscle to tendon, but its three-dimensional organization and dynamics remain poorly characterized. Here, we generate a Col22a1-EGFP knock-in mouse that enables direct visualization and quantitative analysis of MTJs from embryonic development to adulthood. Tissue-clearing and three-dimensional imaging reveal extensive variation in MTJ morphology and spatial distribution among skeletal muscles and between myofiber types. During embryonic MTJ formation, COL22A1-EGFP undergoes a striking transition from intracellular puncta within developing myofibers to extracellular accumulation at myofiber tips, associated with polarized Golgi organization. We further identify complex tendon protrusions that emerge during postnatal growth and connect tendon bodies with subsets of MTJs. These interfaces contain morphologically distinct Scx-lineage cells that express Col22a1, identifying a specialized tendon-associated population at the MTJ. Finally, muscle unloading and overload differentially alter COL22A1-EGFP signal intensity and area, respectively, demonstrating that the reporter provides a quantitative readout of MTJ responses to altered mechanical conditions. Thus, Col22a1-EGFP reveals previously unrecognized spatial, developmental, and adaptive features of the muscle-tendon interface and provides an experimental platform for investigating MTJ biology in vivo.

items.title_en: Non-exonic read content reorganises lncRNA co-expression networks in renal and other cancers
items.title_zh: 非外显子读段内容重塑肾癌和其他癌症中的lncRNA共表达网络
items.abstract_en: Co-expression networks are used to find prognostic lncRNA programmes, but lncRNA quantification depends on unprocessed RNA in the library. In renal cancer (1,062 patients), the leading lncRNA axis tracked the non-exonic (non-feature) read fraction, a routine alignment metric, at Spearman rho 0.90. Without adjustment, most of the lncRNA network merged into one module. Adjustment preserved agreement with single-cell tumour-normal differences. Under rules fixed with the renal results known, 9 of 25 TCGA cancer types had a lncRNA-specific axis and 4 had network collapse (8 and 2 of 23 non-renal types). Intronic lncRNAs tracked the metric more than intergenic ones in all 25, and the metric was not consistently prognostic. All five renal modules that survived adjustment kept their direction in an external cohort, two nominally significant and none at a 5% false discovery rate. Three localised to malignant or epithelial cells. Together they added no discrimination over TNM and grade.

items.title_en: An integrated data exploration engine of knowledge, expression and genetic association for human transposable elements
items.title_zh: 面向人类转座元件的知识、表达与遗传关联一体化数据探索引擎
items.abstract_en: Transposable elements (TEs) constitute a substantial fraction of the human genome and contribute to genomic and epigenomic regulation. However, TE-related knowledge remains fragmented across the literature and databases, with inconsistent identifiers hindering integration and reuse. Here, we present TE-Dee (Transposable Element Data Exploration Engine), a curated resource that harmonizes literature-derived TE relationships with TE annotations, tissue-specific expression, and GTEx v11 eQTL associations. TE-Dee contains 10,387 entities and 9,583 curated relationships from 2,308 publications, 1,505 leaf-level TE classification records, and 11,334,060 instance-level observations generated by intersecting 640,456 reference TE intervals with significant variant-gene associations across 50 GTEx tissue categories. By linking molecular knowledge to genomic, transcriptomic and genetic evidence, TE-Dee provides reusable data for investigating TE biology, gene-regulatory and disease-related mechanisms, and a structured corpus for training and benchmarking data-driven and artificial intelligence models. TE-Dee is available at https://bis.zju.edu.cn/tedee/.

items.title_en: Antihypertensive medications and risk of Parkinson's Disease: multi-cohort trial emulation and transcriptomic analyses
items.title_zh: 抗高血压药物与帕金森病风险：多队列试验模拟和转录组分析
items.abstract_en: Summary Background No known treatments prevent Parkinson's disease (PD) onset or delay its progression. Prior observational studies of antihypertensive medications and PD risk have produced inconsistent findings and may be susceptible to confounding and reverse causation. Methods We applied a multi-stage analytical framework integrating medication-wide screening, independent cohort replication, target trial emulation, and exploratory transcriptomic analyses. Medication-wide association screening was conducted in a large-scale electronic health record (EHR)-linked biobank using logistic regression, with replication in independent cohorts. For candidate drug classes, we emulated a target trial among individuals with primary hypertension initiating first-line antihypertensive therapy in the Merative MarketScan Medicare Database. Incident PD was the primary outcome, and associations were estimated using inverse-probability-of-treatment-weighted Cox proportional hazards models. Exploratory transcriptomic analyses integrated single-cell drug-perturbation data with PD brain expression datasets. Findings Across medication-wide screening and independent cohort replication, losartan (an ARB) and amlodipine (a CCB) were consistently associated with lower odds of PD. The target trial emulation included 269,617 individuals with primary hypertension (25,965 ARB initiators; 36,873 CCB initiators; and 206,779 initiators of other first-line antihypertensives). ARB initiation was associated with a lower hazard of incident PD than initiation of other first-line antihypertensives (adjusted HR [aHR] 0.70, 95% CI 0.59-0.83); the corresponding association for CCB initiation was smaller (aHR 0.88, 95% CI 0.77-0.99). The ARB association was generally consistent across sensitivity analyses addressing alternative exposure definitions, measured prodromal PD characteristics, and comparator choice, but was attenuated at a 5-year PD outcome lag. ARB initiation was also associated with a lower PD risk than ACE inhibitor initiation (aHR 0.81, 95% CI 0.67-0.97). Exploratory transcriptomic analyses showed directional opposition between PD-associated molecular signatures and transcriptional changes after sacubitril/valsartan exposure. Interpretation ARBs initiation was associated with a lower risk of incident PD than initiation of other first-line antihypertensive medications. The attenuation observed for 5-year lag time leaves room for alternative explanations including the influence of prodromal disease on ARB use, delayed ascertainment, and other possible sources of bias. These findings warrant prospective evaluation but do not endorse ARB use for the clinical prevention of PD.

items.title_en: Serum PFOS Concentration and Isomer Composition in Relation to Depressive Symptoms in Young Adults
items.title_zh: 血清PFOS浓度及异构体组成与年轻人抑郁症状的关系
items.abstract_en: Total serum perfluorooctane sulfonate (PFOS) concentration and its isomer composition describe different aspects of internal exposure, but their respective associations with depressive symptoms remain uncertain. We examined adults aged 18-25 years in NHANES August 2021-August 2023 using survey-weighted models of the Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9). Total measured PFOS was the sum of linear PFOS and pooled monomethyl-branched PFOS; composition was their log-ratio. The analytic cohort included 169 participants, with 147 complete cases for core adjustment. Median total PFOS was 1.70 ng/mL, the median linear fraction was 72.2%, and the weighted prevalence of PHQ-9 [≥]10 was 22.6%. In the joint adjusted model, a doubling of total PFOS at fixed composition corresponded to -0.49 PHQ-9 points (95% CI, -1.65 to 0.68); a doubling of the linear-to-branched ratio at fixed total corresponded to 0.21 points (-1.94 to 2.36). Algebraic rescaling across the reported interquartile ranges yielded differences of -0.58 points (-1.95 to 0.81) for total PFOS and 0.13 points (-1.16 to 1.41) for composition. The inverse continuous-score association weakened with adjustment, whereas the screening odds ratio primarily lost precision. Excluding three observations with an isomer below detection shifted both joint coefficients. The data therefore do not establish an independent composition association or equivalent isomer effects. Experimental evidence supports candidate oxidative, inflammatory, and synaptic pathways, but differential protein binding and elimination prevent a serum composition ratio from being interpreted directly as brain dose or toxicity. Larger longitudinal analyses with isomer-resolved exposure and toxicokinetic measurements are needed to test these pathways.

items.title_en: Practice-Based Insights into Adult Genetic Medicine: High Diagnostic Yield, Indication-Specific Results, and Patterns of Test Utilization across 10,000 Patient Encounters
items.title_zh: 基于实践的成人遗传医学洞见：高诊断率、适应证特异性结果以及10,000例患者就诊中的检测利用模式
items.abstract_en: Genetic medicine has become a routine component of clinical care, yet the evidence guiding its implementation remains heavily weighted toward pediatric populations, with limited practice-level data to inform adult referral pathways, test selection, or service delivery. We analyzed eight years of electronic health record (EHR)-linked data from a high-volume adult genetics clinic (9,867 visits) within a major academic health system to define referral patterns, test utilization, and genetic testing outcomes across indications and demographic groups. While most visits were in-person and led by a genetics-trained physician, genetic counselor-only visits accounted for 12% of all encounters and telemedicine remained a substantial component of follow-up care, comprising 39% of follow-up visits from 2023 onward. Genetic testing was ordered for 52% of all new patients, with significant indication-specific variation in ordering propensity. Overall, 24% of all tests returned a diagnostic result. Diagnostic yield differed markedly by testing modality: exome sequencing yielded diagnoses in 40% of patients, whereas next-generation sequencing panels, the most frequently ordered testing type, yielded diagnoses in only 16%. Although diagnostic yield declined with increasing patient age, it remained above 17% in every age stratum, with the yield of exome/genome sequencing remaining above 30% across all age groups. Outcomes varied significantly by referral indication, with some indications yielding significantly high rates of pathogenic findings, and others more often yielding negative or uncertain results. Operational factors significantly shaped practice: test type and laboratory utilization shifted significantly over time in step with payer and testing lab policy changes. Together, these practice-based data establish adult genetics as a high-yield and important clinical domain. Our findings provide actionable evidence to inform age- and indication-aware triage, guide workforce planning, promote adult-focused practice guidelines, better inform payor reimbursement policies, and advance the integration of genomic medicine into routine adult patient care.

items.title_en: Enhancing Scientific Validity by Integrating EHR and Claims Data in the National Clinical Cohort Collaborative
items.title_zh: 通过在国家临床队列协作中整合EHR和理赔数据提升科学有效性
items.abstract_en: Purpose: Accurately capturing a patient's health journey is essential for ensuring the validity of scientific and public health studies. Electronic health records (EHR) and administrative claims are commonly used in healthcare research, albeit separately. Previous research has demonstrated that EHR and claims capture different aspects of patient history and care, potentially introducing bias when used alone. In this study, we leveraged the largest public US EHR resource, the National Clinical Cohort Collaborative (N3C), alongside Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) claims data to compare their information coverage and agreement. Methods: We integrated N3C EHR and CMS data to create one cohesive dataset and quantified the proportion of key variables present in EHR alone, CMS alone, and the overlap present in both data sources. Overlap in information coverage was quantified pre- and post-landmark diagnosis of COVID-19. To evaluate the impact of data coverage differences, we conducted a case study evaluating the effect of COVID-19 vaccination on ischemic stroke using both data sources alone and in combination. Results: CMS data helped identify many individuals that were duplicated among EHR identifiers. Examination of the overlap showed that CMS data more completely captured conditions, while EHR data more completely captured medications after COVID-19 diagnosis. Some variables exhibited marked differences over time after landmark COVID-19 diagnosis. Using target trial emulation and self-controlled case series methods, we found that data capture variations altered effect estimates: EHR data alone yielded lower risk of ischemic stroke after vaccination in the target trial emulation (odds ratio 0.47, 95% CI 0.28-0.79), with a smaller, non-significant reduction in the self-controlled case series (incidence rate ratio 0.81, 95% CI 0.64-1.02), whereas analyses using CMS data alone or both sources combined yielded estimates close to the null in both designs. Conclusions: Results indicated that when using either a national database combining multiple EHR sources, or CMS claims data alone, patients' medical histories are less completely captured compared to when these data sources are combined. Case study results highlighted the value of combining data sources for not only yielding fuller patient health histories and valid scientific results, but for identifying and explaining biases that may emerge in research studies that rely on a single data source.

items.title_en: Neighborhood socioeconomic status and environmental burden show diverging associations with cognitive impairment in community-dwelling older adults
items.title_zh: 邻里社会经济地位和环境负担与社区居住老年人认知障碍的关联呈现分化
items.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: Research on neighborhood context and cognitive health often relies on composite indices that collapse neighborhood socioeconomic status (SES) and aspects of the built environment into a single score. This study examined the extent to which neighborhood SES and built environment were associated with late-life cognitive impairment. METHOD: Participants were 281 predominantly Black older adults who completed the Self-Administered Gerocognitive Exam (SAGE), a brief cognitive screening measure. Participants also provided their home address to obtain four neighborhood metrics: Two composite measures of neighborhood disadvantage, the Environmental Justice Index (EJI) and the EJI Social-Environmental Rank, as well as the EJI Social Vulnerability Rank as a measure of neighborhood SES, and the EJI Environmental Burden Rank to measure exposure to hazardous aspects of the built environment. RESULTS: Lower neighborhood SES was associated with higher odds of cognitive impairment. In contrast, greater environmental burden was associated with lower odds of impairment, with years of education as a moderator; the association was strongest among individuals with high levels of education. The two composite scores were not associated with cognitive impairment. CONCLUSION: Composite measures of neighborhood features may obscure distinct pathways of their effects on cognition.

items.title_en: KNOWLEDGE OF METABOLIC SYNDROME, LIFESTYLE RISK BEHAVIOURS AND PREVENTIVE PRACTICES AMONG WOMEN ATTENDING KASOA POLYCLINIC, GHANA: A CROSS-SECTIONAL STUDY.
items.title_zh: 加纳Kasoa Polyclinic就诊女性对代谢综合征的知识、生活方式风险行为与预防实践：一项横断面研究
items.abstract_en: Background. Metabolic syndrome is a cluster of cardiometabolic risk factors that may increase the risk of cardiovascular disease and type 2 diabetes, and African studies report a higher prevalence in women than in men. Prevention may depend, in part, on whether women recognise the condition and its modifiable risk factors. Relatively little appears to be known about this among women using primary-level health facilities in fast-growing peri-urban areas of Ghana. Objective. To assess knowledge of metabolic syndrome, describe lifestyle risk behaviours, self-reported cardiometabolic conditions and preventive practices, and examine selected lifestyle correlates of self-reported diabetes and hypertension among women attending Kasoa Polyclinic, Ghana. Methods. A descriptive cross-sectional survey was conducted in June and July 2024 among 174 women aged 18-45 years recruited by convenience sampling. A structured, interviewer-assisted questionnaire covered knowledge, lifestyle behaviours, self-reported diagnoses and preventive practices. Data were summarised as frequencies and percentages, and associations were examined with Pearson's chi-square test. Results. Only 37 women (21.3%) described metabolic syndrome as a condition that raises the risk of heart disease and type 2 diabetes, 40 (23.0%) identified central (apple-shaped) fat as the high-risk pattern and 31 (17.8%) knew that dietary recommendations exist. Most reported no weekly physical activity (116; 66.7%), daily sugary drinks (109; 62.6%), daily processed or fast food (100; 57.5%), high stress (103; 59.2%), and less than six hours' sleep (94; 54.0%). Self-reported diagnoses were hypertension in 60 (34.5%) and type 2 diabetes in 49 (28.2%). Fifty-nine (33.9%) had never received advice on prevention and 105 (60.3%) did not monitor their weight or waist. Self-reported diabetes was associated with short sleep (36.2% among those sleeping under six hours; p = 0.035) and with stress level (p = 0.028), being most frequent among women reporting low stress. Self-reported hypertension was more common with high stress (42.7%; p = 0.022) and with some physical activity (p = 0.005). Conclusion. Women attending this polyclinic appeared to have limited understanding of metabolic syndrome and a high burden of modifiable risk behaviours. Routine counselling on diet, activity, sleep, and weight monitoring at the polyclinic may be warranted. The bivariate, self-reported associations should be interpreted cautiously.

items.title_en: Peak Agricultural Pesticide Spray Seasons Are Associated with worse Negative Affect and Behavioral Dysregulation in Adolescents and Young Adults: A 2-Year Ecological Momentary Assessment Study in ESPINA
items.title_zh: 农业农药喷洒高峰季节与青少年和年轻人更严重的负面情绪和行为失调相关：一项在ESPINA中进行的为期2年的生态瞬时评估研究
items.abstract_en: Introduction: Pesticide exposure has been associated with poorer mental health, yet little is known about whether seasonal fluctuations in agricultural pesticide use are associated with cyclical changes in mood among people living in agricultural communities. We evaluated associations between 10 peak and off-peak pesticide spray seasons and ecological momentary assessment (EMA)-derived mood in a floricultural region in Ecuador. Methods: 496 participants completed repeated EMA surveys across 10 assessment administrations over 2.5 years (2022-2024), including one single-assessment administration and nine 10-day bursts (Nobservations=14,332). Mood outcomes included negative affect (sadness, anxiety, stress, anger, tiredness, difficulty concentrating; overall mean=2.79, Standard Deviation [SD]=1.32), positive affect (happiness, motivation; overall mean=4.21, SD=1.60), and behavioral dysregulation (aggression and impulsivity, overall mean=1.86, SD=1.29). Generalized linear mixed models estimated pooled, between-person and within-person associations between peak pesticide spray seasons and mood, adjusting for demographic and longitudinal factors Effect modification by sex, floricultural occupation, and cohabitation with a floricultural worker was assessed. Results: Peak spray seasons were associated with higher negative affect ({beta}=0.11 [0.06, 0.16]) and behavioral dysregulation ({beta}=0.10 [0.05, 0.15]) but not positive affect ({beta}=0.01 [-0.05, 0.07]). Associations were driven by within-person changes. Sex modified associations with negative affect, which were stronger in males than females. Floricultural occupation modified associations, with poorer mood, greater behavioral dysregulation and lower positive affect among floricultural workers than non-workers. Discussion: Peak pesticide spray seasons were associated with worsening of negative affect and behavioral dysregulation. EMA may provide a sensitive approach for detecting short-term neurobehavioral changes associated with seasonal pesticide exposure.

items.title_en: Patient Perceptions of Student Involvement and Satisfaction in a Student-Run Free Clinic Serving People Experiencing Homelessness
items.title_zh: 患者对为无家可归者服务的由学生运营的免费诊所中学生参与和满意度的感知
items.abstract_en: Background: Patient satisfaction is a key measure of healthcare quality among people experiencing homelessness. Student-run free clinics (SRFCs) provide care to underserved populations, but the role of student involvement in patient satisfaction remains unclear. Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional study of patients receiving care at an SRFC. From February 2024 to February 2025, patients completed post-visit surveys assessing satisfaction that were evaluated using regression analyses. Results: Eighty-eight patients completed surveys, reporting high overall satisfaction (mean 9.26/10). In separate linear regression models adjusted for age, gender, and race, greater perceived benefit of student involvement was associated with higher satisfaction ({beta} = .298, p = .037), whereas perceiving the visit as too long was associated with lower satisfaction ({beta} = -.285, p = .019). Conclusion: Greater perceived benefit of student involvement was associated with higher patient satisfaction, whereas longer perceived visit duration was associated with lower satisfaction. These findings highlight the importance of balancing educational opportunities with efficient workflows in SRFCs.

items.title_en: Selective vulnerability of human basal forebrain subsystems in ageing and neuropsychiatric disorders
items.title_zh: 人类基底前脑子系统在衰老和神经精神疾病中的选择性脆弱性
items.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: The basal forebrain (BF) provides the principal cholinergic innervation to the cortex and the hippocampus and is among the earliest regions affected by neurodegenerative processes. Yet, whether its subnuclei differ in how their structural integrity changes with age and in their vulnerability to neurological and psychiatric disorders is unresolved. METHODS: Here, in 81,870 UK Biobank participants aged 45-87 years, we built age- and sex-specific normative models of grey-matter volume in the nucleus basalis of Meynert (Ch4) and the septal/diagonal-band (Ch1-3) compartments of the BF and derived individual deviation from these norms. We then tested the selectivity of their normative deviation profile across cross-sectional and longitudinal ageing, manifest neurological and psychiatric disorders, pre-diagnostic neurodegeneration, prospective disease incidence, and neuropsychiatric polygenic liability. RESULTS: The two compartments followed distinguishable age-related profiles across mid-to-late adulthood, which persisted when examined using longitudinal data. Deviation from norms was generally concentrated in Ch4 across neurological diseases and, in almost no condition, greater in the Ch1-3. The Ch4 deficit was further detectable years before diagnosis, was not substantially explained by common inherited genetic risk, and was linked with incident dementia and Parkinson's disease, whereas Ch1-3 carried no independent prospective structural vulnerability. DISCUSSION: These findings identify an anatomically specific age-related profile of the human BF, with structural vulnerability manifest and pre-diagnostic neurological disorders, which is not substantially explained by common inherited risk.

items.title_en: Levodopa Preferentially Reorganizes Dorsal Subthalamic Activity in Parkinsons Disease
items.title_zh: 左旋多巴优先重组帕金森病中的背侧丘脑底核活动
items.abstract_en: Background: Dopamine replacement reshapes subthalamic activity in Parkinson's disease, but whether this response reflects anatomically organized network reconfiguration remains unclear. Objectives: To determine whether levodopa preferentially reorganizes dorsal subthalamic spectral activity and cortico-subthalamic directionality. Methods: Twelve participants undergoing bilateral subthalamic deep brain stimulation contributed 30 contacts (14 dorsal, 16 ventral). Recordings obtained OFF and ON medication underwent spectral parameterization and multiband state-space analysis. Simultaneous electroencephalography in six participants enabled assessment of directional cortico-subthalamic coupling using the phase slope index. Results: Levodopa suppressed beta power more strongly dorsally than ventrally (-2.473 versus -0.120 dB; p=0.0438). Dorsal theta power increased, with a trend toward an increase after baseline normalization (p=0.07). Dorsal contacts exhibited greater theta-beta (+5.904 versus +1.610 dB; p=0.006) and gamma-beta (+2.516 versus +0.384 dB; p=0.0188) state-space shifts, principally driven by beta suppression. Gamma changes did not differ regionally. Concurrently, dorsal low-beta and beta interactions shifted toward cortical leading at selected electrodes, whereas ventral responses were less consistent. Conclusions: Levodopa produces a topographically organized subthalamic response, combining preferential dorsal beta suppression with altered cortico-subthalamic directionality. These findings position contact anatomy as a key consideration in characterizing dopaminergic network responses and motivate clinical validation of spatially informed multiband biomarkers for adaptive stimulation.

items.title_en: inClinico Agent for clinical trial endpoint prediction and prospective evaluation
items.title_zh: inClinico智能体用于临床试验终点预测和前瞻性评估
items.abstract_en: High attrition rates across clinical drug development impose immense clinical and financial burdens, yet prospectively forecasting whether an individual trial will achieve its primary endpoint remains challenging. Here we present a machine-learning system that predicts clinical trial success across phases I-IV, independently modeling studies with efficacy versus safety/toxicity primary endpoints. To prevent lookahead bias and outcome leakage, models are trained on registration-time features, including target and mechanism-of-action precedent, drug modality and novelty, trial design and operational characteristics, and frozen literature-derived target-choice embeddings. Each prediction yields a continuous Predictive Trial Index (PTI) between 0 and 1 reflecting success probability. On a test set of trials initiated in 2021 or later, the efficacy model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.828 (95% CI 0.812-0.845; n = 2,347) and the safety/toxicity model reached 0.809 (95% CI 0.787-0.831; n = 1,485). These models are embedded in inClinico Agent, an agentic AI system integrating frontier large language models (LLMs) with deterministic scoring engines, retrieval tools and specialized clinical skills. We also introduce ClinBench, a prospective benchmark of 2,040 ongoing trials evaluated by inClinico Agent and five frontier LLMs, establishing a leakage-free foundation for tracking prospective predictive accuracy as trials reach completion.

items.title_en: Readiness to start long acting injectable HIV treatment and prevention and conditions for acceptance among clinic clients in Uganda
items.title_zh: 乌干达诊所客户开始长效注射型HIV治疗和预防的准备度及接受条件
items.abstract_en: Long-acting injectable human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) medicines expand treatment and prevention choices, but willingness to use them does not establish readiness to begin. We examined readiness to start these options, associated factors and conditions for acceptance among people living with HIV and pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP)-service clients in Uganda. This cross-sectional study analysed 225 participants at Mildmay Hospital and Kajjansi Health Centre IV in central Uganda. Readiness meant preferring initiation immediately or within three months. Modified Poisson regression estimated adjusted prevalence ratios (aPRs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs), including age-by-service-group interaction. Separate models examined informational, perceptual and financial factors, adjusting for service group, age and sex. Logistic marginal standardisation checked demographic and expanded age comparisons. Overall, 108 participants (48.0%) were ready to start injectable HIV treatment or prevention, 111 (49.3%) wanted more information about these options, and six (2.7%) preferred initiation in six to twelve months. Readiness was 80.8% among people living with HIV aged 15-24 years and 34.4% among those aged 25 years or older (aPR 2.35, 95% CI 1.63-3.38). Corresponding proportions among PrEP-service clients were 39.2% and 41.4% (aPR 0.95, 95% CI 0.60-1.50; interaction p=0.002). In separate adjusted models, clinic-staff information (aPR 1.94, 95% CI 1.42-2.66), belief in greater effectiveness (2.00, 1.43-2.80) and a one-point increase in benefit score (3.27, 2.36-4.55) were associated with higher readiness. A one-point increase in concern score (0.70, 0.60-0.80) and financial difficulty sometimes or more often (0.68, 0.48-0.96) were associated with lower readiness. Fewer side effects was the leading condition for accepting injectable HIV treatment or prevention across service and readiness groups. Nearly half of participants were ready to start, while a similar proportion wanted further information about injectable options. Programmes should assess intended initiation timing alongside willingness and address safety, appointment flexibility, privacy and affordability through counselling and service planning.

items.title_en: Beyond Usual Pace: Quick Walking Speed and Brain Health Outcomes in the Framingham Heart Study
items.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Stroke, dementia, and late-life depression share overlapping vascular pathophysiology, yet simple markers of shared neurological vulnerability across these conditions remain limited. Most gait research has relied on usual walking speed (UWS) alone, leaving it unclear whether quick walking speed (QWS) and gait adaptability (QWS minus UWS), relate to these conditions in the same way. METHODS: We examined associations of UWS, QWS, and gait adaptability with executive function, verbal memory, depressive symptoms, and incident stroke and dementia in the Framingham Heart Study Offspring cohort. A larger sample (n=2,308; mean age 61.5 years [SD 9.2]; 54% women) was used for cross-sectional and stroke analyses, and a dementia-free sample of 1,148 participants aged 60 years or older (mean age 68.5 years [SD 5.8]; 53% women) was used for analyses of incident dementia. We estimated associations per SD slower walking or smaller adaptability using linear, logistic, and Cox regression (10-year follow-up), overall and in women and men. RESULTS: Slower QWS and UWS were each associated with worse executive function, higher odds of high depressive symptoms (QWS OR 1.24, 95% CI 1.07-1.45; UWS OR 1.26, 95% CI 1.09-1.46), and greater hazard of incident stroke (QWS HR 1.30, 95% CI 1.03-1.64; UWS HR 1.36, 95% CI 1.11-1.65). Executive function and stroke associations were observed primarily in men (stroke QWS HR 1.55, 95% CI 1.11-2.17). For incident dementia, slower QWS reached significance (HR 1.34, 95% CI 1.10-1.63), while UWS did not (HR 1.20, 95% CI 0.98-1.46). Lower gait adaptability was associated with worse executive function overall and in women and men, and with incident dementia in women (HR 1.35, 95% CI 1.04-1.76), but not with depressive symptoms or stroke. No gait measure was associated with delayed recall. CONCLUSION: Slower QWS was associated with incident dementia; UWS was not. Adding a brief quick walking trial to routine gait assessment may identify risk that habitual-pace screening overlooks.

items.title_en: Spatial variation and correlates of raised blood pressure in Cambodia: a Gaussian-process geostatistical analysis of the 2023 STEPwise survey
items.abstract_en: Introduction: Raised blood pressure is an important cardiovascular risk factor in Cambodia; however, national averages may obscure substantial local geographic heterogeneity. We assessed the spatial distribution of raised blood pressure and its demographic, metabolic, behavioural, built-environment, and environmental correlates using the 2023 Cambodia STEPwise approach to noncommunicable disease (NCD) risk factor surveillance (STEPS) survey. Methods: We analysed 289 georeferenced primary sampling units (PSUs) from the 2023 Cambodia STEPS Survey. PSU-level case counts and numbers of adults with valid blood pressure data were modelled using a frequentist binomial generalised additive model with a two-dimensional Gaussian-process smooth. An explanatory model included selected PSU-level and contextual covariates; a separate mapping model used spatially continuous predictors to generate predictions on a 5-km grid. Design-based national and residence-specific prevalence estimates were calculated separately using the survey design and Step-2 weights. Results: Among 4,225 adults with valid blood pressure data, unweighted prevalence of raised blood pressure was 28.6%, compared with 18.8% after Step-2 weighting; weighted prevalence was 17.5% in rural areas and 21.7% in urban/suburban areas. Mean observed unweighted PSU-level prevalence was 29.0%. In the adjusted spatial explanatory model, the proportion aged 60-69 years ({beta}=1.969, SE=0.327; p<0.001) and overweight/obesity prevalence ({beta}=0.996, SE=0.265; p<0.001) were positive ecological correlates. The spatial model had lower Akaike information criterion and residual deviance than its non-spatial counterpart, although Bayesian information criterion was higher. Prediction uncertainty was greater in some sparsely sampled areas. Conclusions: Raised blood pressure showed significant geographic heterogeneity across Cambodia. Older age composition and overweight/obesity prevalence were positive PSU-level correlates, not individual-level causal effects. Predicted prevalence should be interpreted alongside uncertainty and should complement, rather than replace, design-based STEPS prevalence estimates for geographically informed NCD planning.

items.title_en: Psychometric Properties of the Short-Form Five Facet Mindfulness Questionnaire (FFMQ-15) in Medical Sciences Students: A Cross-Cultural Validation Study with Diagnostic Utility Analysis
items.abstract_en: Objective: Mindfulness is a robust predictor of mental health, yet the psychometric properties of the short-form Five Facet Mindfulness Questionnaire (FFMQ-15) have not been examined in Iranian populations. This study evaluated the psychometric properties, factor structure, and diagnostic utility of the FFMQ-15 among medical sciences students. Participants: A total of 348 students (178 females, 170 males) from Kermanshah University of Medical Sciences participated. Methods: Participants completed the FFMQ-15, Penn State Worry Questionnaire (PSWQ), Difficulties in Emotion Regulation Scale (DERS), and Emotion Regulation Questionnaire (ERQ). Data were analyzed using exploratory and confirmatory factor analyses, composite reliability, and ROC curve analysis. Results: Both EFA and CFA supported the five-factor model, revealing a culturally unique item loading pattern. The FFMQ-15 demonstrated strong convergent and discriminant validity. ROC analysis indicated acceptable diagnostic accuracy for distinguishing high- and low-worry groups (AUC = 0.72, 95% CI: 0.66-0.78). Conclusions: The FFMQ-15 demonstrated acceptable psychometric properties in Iranian medical students. The non-reactivity facet exhibited cultural variability, suggesting that cross-cultural adaptation is essential. The instrument shows promise for screening in high-stress educational settings.

items.title_en: From Evidence to Influence: Medias Role in Informing Urban Health Policies in Bangladesh and Nepal
items.abstract_en: Background Urban inequities are often masked by the misleading notion of an urban advantage, despite persistent unequal access to quality healthcare services. Moreover, negative perceptions about the urban poor and slum-dwellers persist, despite their substantial role in driving and holding up the urban economy. It is thus essential to work with the media to bring visibility to these realities, raise public awareness, and inform more equitable health policies. In low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), evidence remains scarce on how health-related information from media outlets influences policy decisions. This study aimed to understand how journalists get information, engage with stakeholders in the health systems, and contribute to influencing urban health discourse in Bangladesh and Nepal. Methods We conducted a cross-country exploratory qualitative study comprising 30 key informant interviews from Bangladesh and Nepal, including 17 journalists, 10 health policymakers, and 3 public health advocates. Participants were purposively selected to ensure diversity across media types, gender, and professional roles. Interviews were conducted between September 2024 and March 2025. Data were transcribed, translated, and analyzed thematically using NVivo software. Cross-country comparative analysis was carried out to identify common themes and contextual differences. Findings Across both countries, participants relied on multiple and diverse information sources. Government data were often prioritized as a primary source of information, although they were shaped by political influences and accessibility constraints. Research evidence was valued but underutilized due to difficulties in interpreting scientific articles. Urban health issues received limited priority in health news reporting due to journalists constraints in covering multiple issues and financial constraints for in-depth coverage. Additional challenges included inadequate health and urban health-related training, limited fellowship opportunities for investigative reporting, and restricted access to data, while health policymakers and public health advocates frequently questioned the credibility and use of media-reported information. Media engagement in policymaking largely remained indirect and issue-focused or event-driven. However, consistent media coverage raised public awareness and generated public pressure and, at times, indirectly influenced health policy decisions such as immediate inspection after reporting on pesticides, installation of oxygen plants during the pandemic, dengue surveillance, and tobacco control measures and actions. Conclusion In Bangladesh and Nepal, news media play a significant but indirect role in shaping urban health policy decisions. Enhancing journalists capacity, improving access to credible information and data, and continuous engagement of stakeholders could strengthen evidence-informed urban health policymaking. Furthermore, establishing greater independence of journalists and government and community recognition of their responsible health reporting could help and motivate the media to contribute more meaningfully to public debate and policy reform processes.

items.title_en: Quantitative proton density mapping with data-driven reception profile correction derived from macromolecular proton fraction
items.abstract_en: Purpose: Proton density (PD) and macromolecular proton fraction (MPF) are fundamental MR parameters characterizing water and macromolecular content in tissues. Both parameters can be mapped using a time-efficient MRI protocol, though PD maps require additional corrections for the reception profile (RP) non-uniformity and global scaling. Existing PD mapping methods suffer from uncertainties related to PD normalization to reference tissue. This study aimed to develop a data-driven RP correction method for PD mapping based on MPF as an internal scale. Theory and Methods: One-parameter model linking PD and MPF was derived under assumption of proportionality between total macromolecular volume and proton concentration. This model with a uniform parameter value across brain tissues generates a surrogate PD map, which is used to estimate RP from an uncorrected PD map. The proposed algorithm was tested against a common PD mapping method utilizing bias-field correction and normalization to cerebrospinal fluid. Brain MRI data were acquired at 3T from seven healthy individuals. The protocol included 3D multi-echo T1-, PD-, and magnetization-transfer-weighted gradient-echo sequences. Parametric maps were reconstructed using the single-point MPF mapping algorithm with data-driven B1 correction. Results: MPF-based and bias-field corrections yielded similar PD measurements in white and gray matter with no significant bias and remarkably small variability (coefficients of variation <0.6%). Conclusions: MPF-based RP correction enables computationally simple and robust quantitative PD mapping at no additional cost if MPF maps are available. The main advantage of the proposed method is automatic elimination of global scaling that obviates the need for PD normalization.

items.title_en: Integrated transcriptomics identifies key genes and pathways driving CKD to ESRD progression: implications for diagnosis and prognosis
items.abstract_en: Background: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) may progress to stage 5 CKD (end-stage renal disease, ESRD), but stage-associated molecular alterations remain incompletely characterized. This study aimed to identify candidate biomarkers associated with CKD and ESRD. Methods: Two discovery datasets comparing CKD or ESRD with healthy controls were analyzed using differential expression analysis and weighted gene co-expression network analysis. Candidate genes were identified by intersecting differentially expressed genes with key co-expression modules, followed by protein-protein interaction network analysis using Degree, Closeness, and Maximal Clique Centrality algorithms. Candidate genes were evaluated in independent GEO validation datasets and further examined by quantitative real-time PCR and western blotting using clinical blood samples. Results: Ten hub genes were identified, among which EPB42, KLF1, and H3F3A were prioritized for further evaluation. EPB42 showed decreased expression in CKD but increased expression in ESRD, indicating an opposite-direction pattern between the two disease states. KLF1 showed no significant difference between healthy controls and CKD but was increased in ESRD, whereas H3F3A was increased in CKD and further increased in ESRD. Functional enrichment analysis highlighted processes related to oxygen transport, mitochondrial function, muscle-associated processes, and inflammation, suggesting possible involvement of hypoxia-associated oxidative injury and ferroptosis-related processes. Conclusions: Integrated transcriptomic and experimental analyses identified EPB42, KLF1, and H3F3A as candidate stage-associated biomarkers in CKD and ESRD. In particular, the opposite-direction expression pattern of EPB42 may provide additional molecular information for distinguishing CKD from ESRD.

items.title_en: Biallelic BECN1 variants cause neurodevelopmental disorders via AMPA receptor dysregulation
items.abstract_en: Genetic regulation of neurodevelopmental disorders that impair brain development and social interaction is complex and poorly understood. Although emerging evidence suggests a link between neurodevelopmental disorders and autophagy deficits, congenital autophagy gene disorders are rare in humans, and underlying molecular mechanisms remain unknown. Here we demonstrate that the autophagy protein BECN1 is a regulator of neuronal and social development in vertebrate species. We identify rare deleterious biallelic BECN1 variants that cause neurodevelopmental disorders in two unrelated families. Becn1 disruption also causes neuronal and social developmental defects in mouse and zebrafish models. BECN1 serves as an adaptor to recruit Arc to the E3 ubiquitin ligase UBE3A for polyubiquitination and degradation, thereby maintaining postsynaptic AMPA receptor (AMPAR) stability, AMPAR-mediated excitatory neurotransmission, and normal social interaction. Thus, our study illustrates new biology and a non-canonical mechanism by which BECN1 regulates neurodevelopment in humans, mice and zebrafish, via a crosstalk with the ubiquitin-proteasomal machinery.

items.title_en: EEG Correlates of Verbal and Perceptual Reasoning
items.abstract_en: Identifying the neural underpinnings of intelligence is one of the major goals of modern intelligence research. However, few imaging studies explore the high extremes of intelligence, and most use only a single composite IQ score. This study used quantitative EEG recordings to investigate correlations between the EEG variables of individual alpha peak frequency, relative power, and coherence, and scores on verbal and perceptual reasoning tests in participants with IQs from the low-average to exceptionally gifted ranges. Overall, the results did not reveal any pattern of significant relationships between these EEG measures and the two psychometric tests. Since this study had only a small sample, heavily skewed towards the high-IQ end of the scale, no definitive conclusions about the EEG measures and verbal and perceptual reasoning can be drawn. Nevertheless, it reveals many opportunities for further research, and suggestions are made for progressing this topic in the future.

items.title_en: Reciprocity coordinates a three-way trade-off in recurrent neural circuits
items.abstract_en: Biological neural circuits contain both unidirectional and reciprocal connections, but how reciprocity affects circuit computation remains unclear. We varied reciprocity \r{ho} across 21 levels in recurrent-network simulations while holding network size, connection density, and directed-edge count fixed. Low-reciprocity networks produced more diverse stimulus-driven activity and performed better on four continuous-input tasks, whereas higher reciprocity generally improved performance on three delayed-memory tasks. Increasing reciprocity reduced online memory capacity and accelerated recovery from perturbations. A post-cue noise experiment showed that higher reciprocity suppressed internal noise propagation but made cue-evoked states less distinguishable, and component matching separated the contributions of cue separation and within-cue dispersion to readout robustness. Within this ensemble, reciprocity thus mediates a three-way trade-off among representational capacity, local stability, and task-state separability: higher reciprocity lowers capacity, strengthens stability, and compresses separability. Whether it improves behaviour depends on whether the stability gain outweighs the lost separation between task states. Connectome and microcircuit datasets from five species showed intermediate reciprocity, while reciprocity varied substantially across adult Drosophila brain regions, providing compatible structural context and motivating circuit-specific functional tests.

items.title_en: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
items.title_zh: 用大语言模型发现最先进的量子电路
items.abstract_en: Significant efforts are currently being directed toward the implementation of large-scale quantum information processors, but realizing useful quantum advantage also requires the development of efficient quantum algorithms. While for many practical problems the dominant resource costs are associated with a small set of computational primitives, optimizing them in the quantum setting presents unique challenges, including a reversibility constraint absent from ordinary classical computation. Here we introduce an evolutionary framework in which large language models (LLMs) propose circuit designs and an independent evaluator verifies and scores them. We apply this framework to tasks spanning numerical computation, chemistry, optimization, quantum simulation, and number theory. In seven of the eight tasks, the discovered circuits significantly reduce both Toffoli and qubit counts relative to the state of the art. In the eighth, the search discovers a new reversible architecture for prime-field modular inversion. By handling reversibility differently, the architecture makes divsteps -- a classical algorithm previously impractical for reversible integer arithmetic -- viable and substantially improves the Toffoli-qubit trade-off for modular inversion. These results open the door for evaluator-guided LLM co-design of new algorithmic structures for quantum computation.
items.abstract_zh: 目前大量努力投向大规模量子信息处理器的实现，但要真正实现有用的量子优势，还需发展高效的量子算法。许多实际问题的主要资源开销集中在少数计算原语上，而在量子情形下优化这些原语面临独特挑战，包括普通经典计算所没有的可逆性约束。本文提出一个进化框架：由大语言模型（LLM）提出电路设计，独立评估器负责验证并打分。我们将该框架应用于数值计算、化学、优化、量子模拟和数论等任务。在8个任务中有7个，所发现的电路同时显著减少了Toffoli门数和量子比特数，优于现有最优结果；在第8个任务中，搜索发现了一种新的素数域模逆可逆架构。该架构以不同方式处理可逆性，使divsteps这一此前难以用于可逆整数运算的经典算法变得可行，并显著改善了模逆的Toffoli-量子比特权衡。这些结果为评估器引导的LLM协同设计量子计算的新算法结构打开了大门。
items.highlight_zh: LLM提电路加独立评估器打分，8个量子任务中7个超越SOTA
items.digest_zh:
1) 研究问题：量子计算要真正有用，除了造硬件，还必须开发高效的量子算法。许多实际问题的主要开销集中在少数“计算原语”（如加法器、模运算电路）上，优化它们收益最大。但量子电路必须满足可逆性约束，这是经典计算中不存在的额外限制，使优化非常困难。
2) 方法：作者构建了一个“进化＋LLM”框架。大语言模型扮演设计者，提出新的电路结构；一个独立的评估器负责验证电路是否正确，并依据Toffoli门数、量子比特数等指标打分。高分设计被保留、变异并进入下一轮迭代，形成自动搜索循环。
3) 结果：在覆盖数值计算、化学、优化、量子模拟和数论的8个任务中，有7个任务所发现的电路同时显著减少了Toffoli门和量子比特数量，超过此前的最优方案。第8个任务是素数域模逆，搜索出了一种新的可逆架构：它用不同方式处理可逆性，使经典divsteps算法（此前难以用于可逆整数运算）变得可行，并大幅改善了模逆在Toffoli门与量子比特之间的权衡。
4) 为何重要：这首次表明“LLM生成＋独立评估器验证”的协同设计能够发明全新的算法结构，而不只是调参或微调现有电路，为量子算法发现提供了可规模化的路径，也为其他需要严格正确性验证的工程设计领域提供了可借鉴的范式。

items.title_en: Stability of Quantum LDPC States under Local Pauli Noise
items.title_zh: 局部 Pauli 噪声下量子 LDPC 态的稳定性
items.abstract_en: Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes have a canonical mixed state---the normalized projector onto the code space---that lies at the intersection of quantum error correction and quantum many-body physics, yet the stability of its information-theoretic structure under local noise remains poorly understood. Recent progress on mixed-state phases of matter has identified the spatial decay of conditional mutual information (CMI) $I(A:C|B)$ as a key diagnostic of such stability, analogous to the role of the spectral gap for quantum ground states. We prove that, for the normalized code-projector state of a $\mathbb{Z}_d$ qLDPC stabilizer code under local Pauli noise, the CMI across a buffer $B$ separating $A$ from $C$ decays exponentially with the width of $B$ in two complementary noise regimes independent of system size. At weak noise, this holds for full-system tripartitions, where correlations between the two sides require an error cluster to cross the buffer, an exponentially unlikely event. At strong noise, exponential decay holds whenever the buffer supports no logical operator, since correlations can persist only along rare chains of buffer qudits that remain informative. Under an additional space-uniformity assumption, we establish the robustness of Levin--Wen topological entropy. On finite-dimensional lattices of size $n$, the weak-noise bound further implies a constant-layer quasi-local Petz recovery channel of range $O(\poly(\log n)/\varepsilon)$ that recovers the noiseless state within trace-distance error $\varepsilon$. Both CMI bounds apply to general qLDPC interaction graphs, including geometries where such constant-depth quasi-local recovery need not exist. Thus, the exponential decay of the noise-induced CMI provides a general criterion for mixed-state phase stability.
items.abstract_zh: 量子低密度奇偶校验（qLDPC）码有一个典型混合态——码空间的归一化投影算符，它位于量子纠错与量子多体物理的交汇处，但其信息论结构在局部噪声下的稳定性仍不清楚。近期混合态物相研究指出，条件互信息（CMI）I(A:C|B) 的空间衰减是此类稳定性的关键判据，类比于基态的谱隙。我们证明：对 Z_d qLDPC 稳定子码在局部 Pauli 噪声下的码投影态，跨越分隔 A 与 C 的缓冲区 B 的 CMI 在两个互补噪声区间内随 B 宽度指数衰减，且与系统尺寸无关——弱噪声时错误须形成穿越缓冲区的团簇，强噪声时只需缓冲区不支持逻辑算符。此外，在空间均匀性假设下证明了 Levin–Wen 拓扑熵的鲁棒性，并在有限格点上给出范围 O(poly(log n)/ε) 的常数层准局域 Petz 恢复信道。结果适用于一般 qLDPC 相互作用图。
items.highlight_zh: qLDPC 码态在局部噪声下条件互信息随缓冲宽度指数衰减
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么：量子低密度奇偶校验码（qLDPC）在纠错与量子多体物理之间天然存在一个混合态——码空间上的归一化投影。问题是：加上局部 Pauli 噪声后，这个态的信息结构还稳定吗？这既是判断 qLDPC 码能否实用的核心问题，也是混合态物相理论关注的焦点。
• 用了什么方法：作者用条件互信息 CMI I(A:C|B) 作诊断量。把系统切成 A、B、C 三段，B 是缓冲区，看 A 与 C 之间还剩多少关联；这种“关联随距离如何衰减”的思路，类比于基态谱隙在纯态相变中的角色。证明针对 Z_d qLDPC 稳定子码加局部 Pauli 噪声。
• 得到什么结果：在两个互补噪声区间里，CMI 都随缓冲宽度指数衰减，且与系统尺寸无关。弱噪声下，A、C 之间的关联必须由一个错误团簇“穿过”缓冲区，概率指数小；强噪声下，只要缓冲区上不存在逻辑算符，关联就衰减。若再加空间均匀性假设，可证明 Levin–Wen 拓扑熵鲁棒。在尺寸为 n 的有限格点上，弱噪声界还蕴含一个常数层、准局域的 Petz 恢复信道，范围 O(poly(log n)/ε)，能把含噪态恢复到无噪态（迹距离误差 ε）。
• 为何重要：这些界对一般 qLDPC 相互作用图都成立，包括那些不存在常数深度准局域恢复的几何，因此 CMI 的指数衰减可当作一个通用的稳定性判据，把混合态物相与量子纠错放进同一套语言。

items.title_en: Magic in quantum trajectory unravelings of noisy random quantum circuits
items.title_zh: 含噪随机量子线路的量子轨迹展开中的 Magic
items.abstract_en: The quantum-trajectory description of a noisy quantum circuit is not unique: every Kraus representation of the noise channel defines a different unraveling, i.e., a different ensemble of pure states that averages to the same density matrix. While all unravelings share the same expectation values of observables, they generally differ in the amount of quantum resources carried by the individual trajectories. Here we study non-stabilizerness, or magic, quantified by the stabilizer Rényi entropy, in quantum-trajectory unravelings of Haar-random and $T$-doped random Clifford brickwork circuits subject to local dephasing noise of strength $p$. The canonical unraveling in terms of Pauli jumps is Clifford and leaves magic untouched, so that trajectories retain the Haar-random value of non-stabilizerness. Exploring the full two-parameter family of minimal unravelings, we find that the trajectory-averaged magic can be substantially reduced by a state-independent choice of Kraus operators, and that the optimal choice is not in general the projective-measurement unraveling, but a two-outcome generalized measurement in which the Kraus operators correspond to a weak measurement of the noisy qubit. The optimal unraveling reduces the extensive magic density of the trajectories by a $p$-dependent factor without altering its linear scaling with system size. At the same time, it produces a very broad distribution of magic over trajectories, with a sizable fraction of trajectories retaining Haar-random magic. Since the cost of stabilizer-based classical simulation grows exponentially with the magic of the state, these high-magic trajectories, rather than the average, control the simulation cost. Our results delineate the potential and the limitations of unraveling optimization as a route to the classical simulation of noisy quantum dynamics with stabilizer methods.
items.abstract_zh: 噪声量子线路的量子轨迹描述并不唯一：噪声信道的每种 Kraus 表示都定义一种不同的展开，即一组平均后得到同一密度矩阵的纯态集合。所有展开给出相同的可观测量期望值，但单条轨迹携带的量子资源通常不同。本文研究 Haar 随机与 T 掺杂随机 Clifford brickwork 线路在强度为 p 的局部退相干噪声下，各量子轨迹展开中的非稳定子性（magic），以 stabilizer Rényi 熵度量。以 Pauli 跳跃定义的规范展开是 Clifford 的，不改变 magic，轨迹保持 Haar 随机值。遍历最小展开的两参数族后，我们发现与状态无关的 Kraus 选择可大幅降低轨迹平均 magic，且最优选择通常不是投影测量展开，而是对应噪声比特弱测量的两结果广义测量。最优展开使轨迹的广延 magic 密度降低一个与 p 相关的因子，但线性标度不变；同时 magic 在轨迹间分布很宽，相当比例的轨迹仍保有 Haar 随机 magic。由于基于稳定子的经典模拟成本随 magic 指数增长，决定成本的是这些高 magic 轨迹而非平均值。
items.highlight_zh: 展开优化可降低平均 magic，但高 magic 轨迹主导模拟成本
items.digest_zh:
• 研究了什么：噪声量子线路除了密度矩阵，还可以用“量子轨迹”来理解——把噪声信道拆成一组纯态，平均后得到同一个密度矩阵。问题在于这种拆法不唯一：噪声信道的不同 Kraus 表示给出不同展开。观测期望值一样，但每条轨迹携带的量子资源 magic（非稳定子性）可以差别很大。
• 用了什么方法：用 stabilizer Rényi 熵度量 magic，研究对象是 Haar 随机以及掺 T 门的随机 Clifford brickwork 线路，受强度 p 的局部退相干噪声。作者系统扫描了最小展开的两参数族，即所有只用两个 Kraus 算符的拆法。
• 得到什么结果：以 Pauli 跳跃给出的规范展开是 Clifford 的，完全不改变 magic，轨迹仍保有 Haar 随机值。但存在与状态无关的 Kraus 选择能显著压低轨迹平均 magic；而且最优选择并非直觉上的投影测量，而是对应“弱测量”噪声比特的两结果广义测量。最优展开把轨迹的广延 magic 密度降低一个依赖 p 的因子，但随系统尺寸仍线性增长；同时 magic 在不同轨迹间分布极宽，仍有可观比例的轨迹保有 Haar 随机级别的 magic。
• 为何重要：基于稳定子的经典模拟，其代价随 magic 指数增长，所以真正决定模拟成本的是那些高 magic 轨迹，而不是平均值。这既说明“优化展开”是一条有潜力的路线，也划出了它的天花板。

items.title_en: Magna: simulating magic state factories as cheaply as Clifford circuits
items.title_zh: Magna：以与Clifford电路同样低的成本模拟魔法态工厂
items.abstract_en: Classical simulation of magic state factories, including distillation, cultivation, and code switching, is challenging because of their substantial non-Clifford content. We introduce $\texttt{magna}$ (magic-state-factory assessment via global network algebra), a classical simulator that simulates such protocols as cheaply as Clifford circuits. $\texttt{magna}$ expresses the figures of merit of a protocol, namely the acceptance rate and the fidelity of the accepted states, as tensor networks, which it reduces globally by exploiting a structural correspondence with transversal gates on quantum codes. $\texttt{magna}$ further supports feedforward conditioned on arbitrary functions of mid-circuit measurement outcomes, including decoder outputs. We simulate Bravyi--Haah distillation with up to 100 output magic states at a cost that does not grow exponentially in the number of outputs, and achieve state-of-the-art sampling times for distance-5 magic state cultivation on both color codes and RP$^2$ surface codes. Finally, we validate nonlinear feedforward on a logical-level distillation protocol with 15 rounds of decoder-dependent feedforward. $\texttt{magna}$ aims to contribute to the key infrastructure for the large-scale evaluation and optimization of magic state factories.

items.title_en: Classical Capacity of Single-Mode Bosonic Gaussian Channels
items.title_zh: 单模玻色高斯信道的经典容量
items.abstract_en: The classical capacity of a noisy optical channel is the maximum rate at which information can be transmitted reliably, given a constraint on the mean input energy. For the ubiquitous bosonic Gaussian channels, which include standard models of loss and noise in fibre and free-space optical links, determining this rate requires addressing whether entanglement between channel uses or non-Gaussian signals can outperform Gaussian encodings. More precisely, the question is whether the energy-constrained Holevo information is additive across arbitrarily many channel uses and coincides with its Gaussian counterpart. We answer these fundamental questions in the affirmative for every single-mode bosonic Gaussian channel at every input energy. Namely, we prove that independently prepared Gaussian states with Gaussian-distributed random displacements achieve the capacity, including in the low-energy regime where squeezing the signals competes with encoding information in their displacement. Our proof connects an entanglement inequality to a sharp, additive lower bound on output entropy. We then characterise communication above capacity: under a strict total photon-number cutoff, the probability of correct decoding decreases exponentially with the number of channel uses, and we derive explicit bounds on the decay exponent. When only the mean photon number is constrained, a simple energy-rescaling formula determines exactly the entire asymptotic rate--error trade-off: the capacity at mean photon number $N$ and allowed average decoding error $ε$ equals the vanishing-error capacity at mean photon number $N/(1-ε)$. Together, these results identify the ultimate limits of classical communication for some of the most fundamental models of optical communication.

items.title_en: Adding Temperature to the Adiabatic Connection: Hybrid Functionals for Static and Dynamic Correlation
items.title_zh: 为绝热连接添加温度：用于静态和动态相关的杂化泛函
items.abstract_en: Capturing static and dynamic electron correlation simultaneously at manageable computational cost remains a key challenge in electronic structure theory. Motivated by the recurring role of effective temperature in self-consistent field methods we extend the adiabatic connection mechanism from density functional theory to include a temperature dimension. This gives rise to thermally enhanced hybrid functionals, in which static correlation is captured via fractional occupations generated by an effective "correlation temperature" within thermal Hartree-Fock, while dynamic correlation is described by established density functional approximations. The framework formally unifies information-density matrix functional theory (i-DMFT) and thermally-assisted-occupation (TAO-)DFT as special cases, clarifying their theoretical basis and the respective prescriptions for the temperature parameter. We assess the performance of several thermally enhanced hybrids for different cases where i-DMFT was previously shown to fail.
